outcome: Maternal complications (e.g., postpartum haemorrhage, abruptio placentae, renal dysfunction, pulmonary edema, pulmonary embolism, HELLP syndrome, disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), eclampsia, maternal mortality)
Fetal outcomes (e.g., low birth weight, preterm delivery, birth asphyxia, stillbirth)
cohort: 200 pregnant women admitted with severe pre-eclampsia at a tertiary care referral unit.
finding: The study found a high rate of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality associated with severe pre-eclampsia, highlighting the need for improved antenatal care and awareness.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 75% of the newborns.
